Remove example records and add your own data.
description: FinTracker ledger-based import file. Uses journal entries (double-entry accounting) for all transactions.

journalEntries._comment: Income: Asset (Dr) from Income (Cr). When money comes IN to an account.
Income: Another account receives money from income
Expense: Expense (Dr) from Asset (Cr). When money goes OUT of an account. Debit an expense category, credit the account it came from.
Expense: From same account as above
Transfer: Asset (Dr) from Asset (Cr). Money between two accounts. Debit destination, credit source.
